events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: William John Paul Gallagher, known as Liam Gallagher, was born on September 21, 1972, and rose to fame as the distinctive voice of Oasis.

angles.name: Iconic Frontman
angles.copy: Love him or… well, you know. Liam Gallagher is 54 today! The iconic frontman has given us some truly unforgettable anthems. What's your favourite Oasis or solo track?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' UK single anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic single 'Imagine' was released in the UK on October 24, 1975, having first appeared on his 1971 album of the same name.

angles.name: Timeless Message
angles.copy: It’s 51 years since John Lennon’s powerful anthem ‘Imagine’ was released as a single in the UK. Its message of peace and unity resonates just as strongly today.

events.title: The first iPod was released
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the revolutionary first-generation iPod on October 23, 2001, changing how the world listened to music.

angles.name: Music Revolution
angles.copy: Remember when this dropped? The first iPod, released in 2001, completely changed how we consumed music. What was the first album you loaded onto yours?

events.title: Global James Bond Day
events.blurb: Global James Bond Day is celebrated annually on October 5th, marking the anniversary of the first James Bond film, 'Dr. No', which premiered in London in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy Global James Bond Day! Raise a martini (shaken, not stirred, naturally) to 007 and over six decades of iconic cinema. Who's your favourite Bond?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: John Lennon, co-founder of The Beatles and an iconic solo artist, would have been 86 on October 9, 2026.

angles.name: Remembering a Legend
angles.copy: Today, we remember the incredible John Lennon, who would have been 86. His music and message continue to inspire generations worldwide. What's your favourite Lennon song?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: English actor, comedian, and writer John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday on October 27, 2026.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the one and only John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, his comedic genius is truly legendary. What’s your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album,' on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: A Double Album Masterpiece
angles.copy: It's 58 years since The Beatles unleashed 'The White Album' on the world. A sprawling, experimental masterpiece that still sounds incredible today. Which track is your go-to?

events.title: Freddie Mercury death anniversary
events.blurb: November 24, 2026, marks 35 years since the passing of legendary Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, who died at the age of 45.

angles.name: Remembering a Icon
angles.copy: 35 years ago today, we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice, stage presence, and legacy continue to rock the world. Forever missed, never forgotten.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their influential album 'Rubber Soul' in the UK on December 3, 1965, marking a significant artistic progression for the band.

angles.name: A Pivotal Album
angles.copy: On this day in 1965, The Beatles released 'Rubber Soul'. Widely considered a turning point in their career, it showcased their evolving sound. What's your favourite track?

events.title: John Lennon death anniversary
events.blurb: December 8, 2026, marks 46 years since the tragic death of John Lennon, who was fatally shot at the age of 40.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: 46 years ago today, the world lost a musical visionary. We remember John Lennon, whose enduring message of peace and love continues to resonate.
